cohort: 6,369 women who gave birth at a tertiary hospital in Portugal between 2014 and 2016
finding: Groups 1, 2, 5, and 10 of the Robson 10 group classification system were the largest contributors to the overall cesarean section rate.
mod_finding: This study analyzes cesarean section rates using the Robson 10 group classification system, which categorizes deliveries by factors such as mode of delivery and previous births.
